newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to tighten food safety rules.
newsitem.headline: EU to tighten food safety rules.

text.p: The European Union's executive, under pressure from Britain and the European Parliament, said on Wednesday it will introduce stricter rules to protect consumers from mad cow disease after EU farm ministers voted narrowly in favour.
EU officials said that ministers voted by eight against seven in favour of a proposal to remove risky animal tissue from human and animal food, cosmetics and medicine.
EU to tighten food safety rules
"The Commission will probably decide next week to go ahead," a European Commission spokesman said.
The majority vote came after the Luxembourg EU Presidency presented a compromise making concessions to Portugal and Finland.

But Spain, which last week supported the proposal at a meeting of EU chief veterinary officers, switched sides because it argued that EU countries were being discriminated against compared with foreign competitors.
Britain welcomed the vote, saying that the same rigorous controls that are applied to British beef will now be put in place across Europe.
